audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart is a blanket 'Skill 5/10' on all seven rows while the content layer and the packet both give Mel 1-5, Brand at 6, Mel from first item. The two layers render different answers.
audit.why: Content win[] matches the packet levelChart exactly and its whys are kit-grounded (Brand needs Blaze setup to stun; Pyroclasm at 6 is his window; Rebuttal reflects his projectiles with items). The full layer never diverged from the template.
audit.corrected: Full phases[0..6].side aligned to content win[], ratings and whys rewritten to match, as one atomic group.

audit.why: Spikes correctly place Mel's window at 3-5, Brand's burst window at 6 (Pyroclasm 100s CD + Blaze detonations), and Mel's reflect-driven swing from first item. All 4 spike entries present.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digits; two Do/Don't bullets were pasted tradeGood/tradeBad; no cooldown numbers anywhere in the full layer.
audit.why: Sear is 8s rank 1, Pillar of Flame 10s, Conflagration 13s, Pyroclasm 100s. Q Sear and R Pyroclasm carry projectile flags Rebuttal returns; the Q-stun requires Blaze — that conditionality is the matchup's core dodge.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns folded into breakdown.cooldowns; bleed bullets replaced with content matching their titles.

audit.why: W Pillar of Flame at 10s is the most punishable whiff; Pyroclasm 100s defines the all-in windows.

edits.before: Q-volley his last-hits — the radiant barrage chips from a range most mids can't answer at one.
edits.after: You out-range him at one — Q-volley his last-hits while his stun still needs Blaze setup he lacks.

edits.before: W online: Rebuttal turns his poke into YOUR poke. The reflect re-prices every projectile in the lane.
edits.after: W online: Sear and Pyroclasm are projectiles — Rebuttal returns his stun setup and re-prices the lane.

edits.before: E completes the kit: the snare into full volley is your kill pattern. Hold it for real windows.
edits.after: E completes the kit: snare the immobile Brand and volley — dodge his 10s Pillar and trades are free.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — volley every wave contact and bank the overwhelm stacks on his health bar.
edits.after: Lost Chapter timing — snare-poke beats his setup; sidestep Pillar of Flame and bank stacks for free.

edits.before: Golden Eclipse online — the execute threshold turns your chip war into a countdown he can see.
edits.after: Pyroclasm's bounces plus Blaze detonations give Brand his one real burst window — respect his 6.

edits.before: Luden's spike: snare-volley chunks half bars and the execute cleans the remainder. Force contacts.
edits.after: Luden's plus maxed W: reflect his Q or R and the poke war swings back — snare-volley, then execute.

edits.before: Late Mel is a counter-artillery battery: reflect their poke, snare their dive, and execute the chipped.
edits.after: Late, immobile Brand cannot escape Solar Snare — reflect his key projectile, execute after his combo.

edits.before: - Brand Sear (Stun): matchup-defining — Q only stuns when you are ablaze — after eating W or E, the stun line is the dodge that matters. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your W Rebuttal like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Brand Sear (Stun): 8s at rank 1 and it only stuns when you're Ablaze — after eating W or E, the stun line is the dodge that matters. - Pillar of Flame is 10s: its whiff is your step-up window. - Pyroclasm is 100s; Rebuttal answers it, so hold the glow.

edits.before: Q-volley the last-hit, bank the overwhelm stacks, and keep W glowing — the chip is free while his best spells are hostages.
edits.after: Root him at the snare's center as he walks up to combo range — immobile Brand has no dash and eats the full volley every time.

edits.before: Burning Rebuttal on chip and then eating the full rotation it existed to return — the reflect is the matchup; spend it like a verdict.
edits.after: Solar Snare is your kill setup and your combo-breaker — spent to shoo him off a minion, his next Ablaze-Sear stun finds you bare.

edits.before: Brand wins by landing Sear (Stun), denying your pattern, and out-ranging your plan one polite trade at a time.
edits.after: Brand wins by stacking Blaze, stunning you with Sear once Ablaze, and detonating the combo before W returns.

notes: Packet defect notes the chart (Mel 6/7 stages) sits oddly against a 47.55% WR; the chart shape itself matches the packet levelChart and kit logic (Brand's only clear window is 6), so I aligned the full layer to it rather than inventing new flips. Brand W carries a projectile derived-flag but Riot's text describes a delayed ground AoE — I avoided asserting Rebuttal reflects W and grounded reflect claims on Q/R; content spikes[2]/late already claim W-reflection (left as-is, unverified). Templated fields judged but left ungrounded: ahead, breakdown.carry, breakdown.feeding, breakdown.difficulty.
